notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Notes
notes.notes: [p]It's been just over a month since Draggin' released, time flies![/p][p]And just in time to celebrate, we set a new patch for Draggin' live. Our lead programmer (me) has been juggling some other important work recently (playing Hollow Knight: Silksong), but we've put together some new additions and fixes we think will make the game a lot more user-friendly.[/p][p]Here's our list of changes for the new 1.0.2 update:[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Additions:[/u][/h3][p]- Clicking is now rebindable from the settings menu![/p][p]- The life bar now has some new sprites that appear when you heal to show you how close you are to max health.[/p][p]- The Combo Meter has some new little icons to make it clearer what the numbers on it actually mean.[/p][p]- Added a few new supported resolutions (QHD and 4K UHD, specifically). That should make the game look nicer on 4k monitors![/p][p][/p][h3][u]Balance Changes:[/u][/h3][p]- Heart drop rate is now tied to how much health you have (more hearts show up when you're low, fewer when you have a lot already).[/p][p]- Health Potions heal 2 hearts instead of 3.[/p][p]- College Fund goal has been raised from 150k to 500k. We've been super impressed with how fast some of y'all are getting Margot to college, so we gotta make it a little tougher.[/p][p][/p][h3][u]Fixes:[/u][/h3][p]- The "Potions" header on the Spellbook screen shows up in the right place now.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue where the combo meter would disappear if you started another combo during its fade out animation.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for playing! As always, if you run into any issues in the new build, or have any feedback for us, the Discord is a great place to make sure we hear about it! We've got some big announcements coming up on the horizon, so stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the new patch, everyone! Now if you'll excuse me, I have to go play Silksong for the next 8 hours.[/p][p]- Alex from Dragon Fractal[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Notes
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539499/b64ae7e5a1ec312ea19555b241e6e592286ffbc3.png"][/img][/p][p]It's time for Draggin's first patch! Welcome to 1.0.1.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who has been giving their feedback or bug reports in our Discord. We've been getting a ton of great info from you on how we can make Draggin a bigger and better game.[/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of making Draggin a better game, here's a list of what we've fixed up with this update![/p][list][*][p]The Lace spell box effect scales properly now.[/p][/*][*][p]Combo meter description should no longer permanently rotate when you take damage.[/p][/*][*][p]The background of the graduation screen now actually covers the whole screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The damage vignette effect no longer flashes on screen when toggling it in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some visual bugs with the blue and purple square spark effects.[/p][/*][*][p]The Winter, Graduate, and Regal costumes now display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some adjustments to the College Fund Meter in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the wording of the Prism spell to match what it actually does. (oops)[/p][/*][*][p]Hoppin draggins should no longer jitter violently when too close to the Fruit spell's sprout.[/p][/*][*][p]Drag Racing challenge now works as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Hitless challenges should now unlock consistently when earned.[/p][/*][*][p]Gold pickups no longer add a message to the combo meter, making it easier to see the names of captured draggins.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]If YOU run into any bugs or have ideas you'd like to see in a future update, hop into our Discord and let us know! We'd be thrilled to see you![/p][p][/p][p]Keep your eyes peeled for more updates and maybe even some sneak peeks at what we're going to be cooking up next.[/p][p][/p][p]- The Dragon Fractal team[/p]

notes.title: Draggin is OUT NOW + Steam Cloud Saves!
notes.notes: [p]Hello draggin wranglers![/p][h2]Draggin has officially launched![/h2][p]We want to thank all of you for your support. It has been an amazing ride - we're so excited to finally share the game with everyone and we look forward to continue making it even better.[/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of, if you have played the game, [b]please leave a review![/b] It bumps us in Steam's algorithm, and your feedback [b](positive AND negative)[/b] lets us know what changes we can make to improve the experience. You can also join our [url="https://discord.gg/uBQSR4aXbX"]Discord server[/url] to report bugs, leave feedback, or opt in to participating in future beta tests. (Also, you can hang out with our community of draggin wranglers!)[/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Cloud Saves[/h2][p]Steam Cloud Saves just went live! This addition was made thanks to player feedback - your input is extremely valuable to us![/p][p][/p][h2]Stay up to date![/h2][p]Any [b]big news[/b] from us will be shared both on our [url="https://discord.gg/uBQSR4aXbX"]Discord server[/url] and in Steam community posts like this one, so be sure to keep an eye out![/p][p][/p][p]Dragon Fractal Games[/p]

notes.title: Draggin' News Blast: Release Date, Beta Testing, and more
notes.notes: [p]Hello all Draggin Wranglers![/p][p]As July comes to an end, we've got a lot of big news to share:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539499/fc7ace7a1225fd76f91a96f2ea471afaf722432e.png"][/img][/p][h3][u]First: Draggin' now has a release date![/u][/h3][p][b]Draggin' will be launching on Steam on August 18th, 2025![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][u]Second: We made a Draggin' Discord![/u][/h3][p]If you're interested in giving feedback on the game, want to see behind-the-scenes details, or just want to stay up to date on the latest Draggin' news, this is the place to be! [url="https://discord.gg/uBQSR4aXbX"]discord.gg/uBQSR4aXbX[/url][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][u]Lastly: We're kicking off some final rounds of Draggin' beta testing before release![/u][/h3][p]You can opt-in to the playtest on our main Steam Page: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3475110/Draggin/"]store.steampowered.com/app/3475110/...[/url] [/p][list][*][p]Playtest instructions and the feedback form can be accessed on the title screen of the beta.[/p][/*][*][p]Average playtime is around 30min[/p][/*][*][p]This playtest will end on Wednesday, 7/23 at 11:59pm CDT[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We're hard at work putting the finishing touches on the game, and it won't be much longer until we can share everything! Until then, keep draggin' on![/p]

notes.title: Our top picks from Steam Next Fest ✨
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello all Draggin' catchers![/b][/p][p]In between working on the game we've been playing a bunch of demos from across Steam Next Fest. We believe it's important to support fellow game devs, so here are our favorite next fest demos we think you should try:[/p][p][/p][p]💎 Gemporium[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3466550/Gemporium_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]This is the best cozy game we've played from the festival, hands down! Inspired by the Pokemon Underground minigame, you mine and sell gems to cute animal customers in order to grow a successful gem emporium. We could play the gem-refining minigame for hours on its own.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/n5KYAjsU" style="button"]Join the Discord![/url][/p][p][/p][p]🐸 Big Hops[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3735820/Big_Hops_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]If you are a fan of 3D platformers this game is a must-try! It takes the best elements of Mario Odyssey and BOTW and glues them together in all the right ways. They're also running a kickstarter right now with some genuinely cool rewards![/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chriswade/big-hops" style="button"]Check the Kickstarter![/url][/p][p][/p][p]🍫 Consume Me[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3438190/Consume_Me_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]One of the most charming games we've played from the festival, Consume Me is a coming of age story that is part life sim, part wario-ware. Every minigame manages to balance being fun with being thematically appropriate, which is no small feat. If you're looking for a quick pick-me-up, this is a great game to try![/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/qdork.bsky.social" style="button"]Follow on Bluesky![/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Demo for Steam Next Fest 🐲✨
notes.notes:

[*] 4 new Spells from the full game
[*] 4 new Costumes, alongside new Sparks and Patterns for your Spellbox
[/list]
